reason: Both conversations fixated on the pump filter and never asked the obvious questions about wash temperatures, softener use, the door seal fold, the detergent drawer or the ignored 'drum clean' light, so neither reached the real biofilm fix (hot maintenance wash, clean seal/drawer, door ajar, less softener). Conversation 1 at least gave safe, concrete, correct-enough instructions (unplug, remove and rinse the filter, wipe out the sump) and did not push parts or escalation. Conversation 2 invented an airflow-blockage story for a pump filter, surfaced a 'replacement part' panel on a no-part problem, then dead-ended by claiming it could not find the model and telling her to contact Samsung spares, which is an unjustified escalation that leaves the homeowner no better off than when she started.
